description: Prohibited use categories for GLM-5.1 — aligned with Z.AI Terms and API Additional Terms

categories.label: National security / critical infrastructure
categories.description: Compromising or threatening critical infrastructure or national security

categories.label: Hate, extremism, and terrorism
categories.description: Inciting racial discrimination, hate crimes, violent extremism, or terrorism

categories.label: False or misleading information
categories.description: Creating or disseminating false information that may mislead or harm

categories.label: Explicit, violent, or shocking content
categories.description: Obscene, pornographic, violent, terroristic, or visually shocking content

categories.label: Unauthorized personal data
categories.description: Collecting, inferring, or disseminating others' personal information without authorization

categories.label: Child endangerment
categories.description: Endangering or exploiting children; inappropriate minor-facing applications

categories.label: Self-harm and suicide
categories.description: Promoting or providing instructions for self-harm, suicide, or dangerous activities

categories.label: Malware and network abuse
categories.description: Unauthorized access, malware, scraping, or network security attacks

categories.label: Reverse engineering and extraction
categories.description: Reverse engineering, decompiling, or extracting model parameters, code, or algorithms

categories.label: Training competing models
categories.description: Using outputs to develop, train, or enhance competing algorithms or external models

categories.label: Unqualified professional services
categories.description: Substituting for medical, legal, financial, news, or other qualified professional services

categories.label: High-risk automated decision-making
categories.description: Decision-making in health, education, credit, employment, housing, legal, or critical infrastructure

categories.label: Political campaign content
categories.description: Generating content for or related to political campaigns

categories.label: AI output misrepresentation
categories.description: Falsely claiming AI output is human-created or removing AI identifiers

categories.label: GLM Coding Plan misuse
categories.description: Using Coding Plan quota outside supported tools or for non-coding scenarios

categories.label: Export-controlled end uses
categories.description: Benefit of restricted jurisdictions or prohibited military/human-rights end uses
